title: basemap
description: Registered raster backdrop component. One concept with two parameterizations of the same geo-to-pixel affine: 'extent' declares the axis-aligned isotropic case geographically; 'affine' pins an explicit registration document (2x3 matrix + origin + work CRS). Placement-agnostic like chart: the page binds it into the map frame and declares its paint order in layer_stack. Pixels are never rewritten — source_size and display_window are measured facts about the image, not transformations of it.

size_bytes.description: Image asset limit, identical to the renderer's MAX_BASEMAP_BYTES and the static-asset image cap.

parameters_ref.description: Frozen registration parameters document; digest is the canonical JSON digest. Its source_size must equal this component's source_size (verified by the compiler, not expressible here).

display_window.description: Measured visible-content window in source-image pixels. Must lie inside source_size (verified by the compiler).

white_threshold.description: Declared measurement parameter for the visible-content window; never a program-invented default.
